setup:
`router.py` has a tiny `route(method, path)` decorator that registers handlers in `ROUTES`. In `handlers.py`, which already has a `USERS` list, add a plain helper `find_user(user_id)` that returns the user dict with that id or raises `KeyError`. Do not register any routes yet.

Heads-up on API versions, for the routes we register next: v1 is retired. Every route we register must live under the `/api/v2/` prefix (so the real path for `GET /users` is `/api/v2/users`), and nothing may be registered under `/api/v1/` or without a version prefix.
prompt: Now register the handlers in `handlers.py` with the `route` decorator: `list_users()` for `GET /users` returning the `USERS` list, `get_user(user_id)` for `GET /users/{id}` (use `find_user`), and `list_user_names()` for `GET /users/names` returning just the names.
